gold: Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis

selector.rationale: Optic Neuritis best explains the relative afferent pupil defect, central scotoma, and impaired color and contrast vision, with supportive evidence from papillary OCT showing progression from discrete right papillary edema to severe optic nerve atrophy

rejected.label: Uveitis
rejected.why: while mild vitreous inflammation is present, it is not sufficient to explain the full range of symptoms

rejected.label: Viral retinitis
rejected.why: negative serologies for common viral retinitis causes and lack of specific findings

rejected.label: SARS-CoV-2 infection
rejected.why: while the patient is positive for SARS-CoV-2, the ocular findings are not typical for COVID-19 related ocular manifestations
